persons.name: Mohana
persons.evidence: ramyaṃ gāruḍakaṃ purāṇam alikhat dhyāyan vibhuṃ mohanaḥ

notes: The date is expressed first in verse with the chronogram netra-ākāśa-gaja (2-0-8 = 802) and nakṣatra Pūrvabhādrapadā, followed by the prose restatement: samvat 802 bhādrapadaśuklatrayodaśisomavāśare.
